code_examples.section: ltm rule command ANTIFRAUD device id
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::device_id
       Returns device id generated by bigip.

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::device_id

DESCRIPTION
		   Returns device id generated by bigip.

RETURN VALUE
		   Returns device id generated by bigip.

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_ALERT {
	    log local0. "device id: [ANTIFRAUD::device_id]."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-15.0.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
